description.blurb: 5011 Ptah is a near-Earth object and potentially hazardous asteroid of the Apollo group. It has an eccentric oribt measures approximately 1.6 kilometers (1 mile) in diameter.
description.more: The potentially hazardous asteroid has a minimum orbit intersection distance with Earth of 0.0256 AU (3,830,000 km) or 10 lunar distances. It passes within that distance of Earth 15 times between 1900 and 2100, most recently on 21 January 2007, at 29.6 million kilometers.
